title: Parsed shadownet://connect URL
description: Schema for the parsed form of a shadownet://connect?... URL. See RFC-0008 § Connect URL scheme. The URL itself is a string; this schema describes what a conforming parser produces.

base.description: Sidecar base URL. https:// in production; http:// allowed only for loopback hosts.

token.description: Inline bearer token. Mutually exclusive with `handoff`.

handoff.description: Short-code to trade at POST <base>/v1/account/connect/handoff/<code>. Mutually exclusive with `token`.
